shortDescription: CoreWeave Inc. co-founder Brannin McBee said investing cash in computing capacity offers better returns than repaying some of the company’s high-yield debt, according to Bloomberg. The debt has drawn scrutiny in recent weeks.

title: CoreWeave’s McBee Sees Better Returns From Data Center Investment Than Debt Repayment
